title: 第0023章 仙茅破障夜袭林府血染青石阶第0024章 后山药园 诡异毒藤 白鲜皮初显威
content_zh:
------
一、残阳如血，绝脉告急
青炎城的黄昏总是来得迟。
夕阳像泼翻的朱砂，沿着青石板路的缝隙流淌，把林家后山的试炼台染得一片猩红。
林药尘坐在试炼台最边缘的断碑上，指尖扣着腕脉，眉头紧锁。
体内那股刚刚修复不久的绝脉，此刻竟传来一阵阵针扎似的刺痛。
“仙鹤草固元的效果……在消退。”
他低声自语，声音里压着一丝不易察觉的焦躁。
自从三日前在大比上硬接了林啸天一记「碎岩掌」，那条被腐骨散腐蚀了三年的绝脉，就像一根断了又勉强粘起来的枯枝，稍有风雨便摇摇欲坠。
系统的提示音在脑海响起：
【警告：宿主绝脉稳定性下降至37%，若三日内未加固，将永久断裂。】
【建议：立即炼化「仙茅」破障，冲击药徒三重。】
林药尘抬头，望向试炼台中央。
那里，林家的核心弟子们仍在切磋，拳风呼啸，劲气四溢。
而他却只能坐在这里，像个局外人。
“林药尘。”
身后传来一道冷淡的声音。
林药尘回头。
是林家大长老身边的亲卫，林虎。
“大长老有令，三日后，家族将重新评定‘药徒位阶’。”林虎居高临下地看着他，嘴角挂着毫不掩饰的讥讽，“你若通不过，就滚出林家，去药铺扫地去吧。”

林药尘没说话，只是缓缓站起身。
他袖中手指微微一颤，不是害怕，而是愤怒在体内翻涌。
“知道了。”他淡淡应了一声，转身离去。
背影单薄，却挺得笔直。
林虎盯着他的背影，啐了一口：“废物就是废物，还装什么镇定。”
------
二、夜色深沉，仙茅破障
夜。
林药尘盘膝坐在破败小院的床榻上，窗外是后山呼啸的风声。
他从怀中取出一只巴掌大的木盒。
打开。
一株通体赤红、根须如龙须般缠绕的草药静静躺着。
仙茅。
凡级上品，破障壮阳，激发潜能，是突破瓶颈的关键奇药。
“系统，开始炼化。”
【开始炼化：仙茅（凡级上品）】
【药力转化中……】
【预计突破：药徒三重（绝脉加固+战力翻倍）】
轰——
一股灼热的气流猛地从丹田炸开，顺着残脉疯狂奔涌。

林药尘闷哼一声，额头瞬间沁出豆大的汗珠。
content_en:
------
1. The setting sun is like blood, and the pulse is in danger
Dusk always comes late in Qingyan City.
The setting sun was like splashed cinnabar, flowing along the gaps in the bluestone road, dyeing the trial platform on the back hill of the Lin family scarlet.
Lin Yaochen sat on the broken monument at the edge of the trial platform, with his fingertips clasping his wrist veins and his brows furrowed.
The broken pulse in the body that had just been repaired was now feeling a stabbing pain like needles.
"The agrimony's strengthening effect... is fading."
He whispered to himself in a low voice, with a hint of imperceptible anxiety in his voice.
Ever since Lin Xiaotian's "Rock Breaking Palm" was forcibly received in the competition three days ago, the dead vein that had been corroded by rotten bone powder for three years was like a dead branch that was broken and barely stuck together, crumbling at the slightest wind and rain.
The system prompt sounded in my mind:
[Warning: The stability of the host's dead veins has dropped to 37%. If it is not reinforced within three days, it will permanently break. 】
[Suggestion: Immediately refine "Curculum" to break the barrier and attack the third level of Medicine Apprentice. 】
Lin Yaochen raised his head and looked towards the center of the trial platform.
There, the core disciples of the Lin family were still sparring, with fists roaring and energy overflowing.
But he could only sit here, like an outsider.
"Lin Yaochen."
A cold voice came from behind.
Lin Yaochen turned around.
It was Lin Hu, the personal guard beside the eldest elder of the Lin family.
"The Great Elder has ordered that in three days, the family will re-evaluate the 'Medicine Disciple Rank'." Lin Hu looked at him condescendingly, with undisguised sarcasm on his lips, "If you can't pass, get out of the Lin family and go to the medicine shop to sweep the floor."
Lin Yaochen didn't speak, but stood up slowly.
The fingers in his sleeves trembled slightly, not because of fear, but because of anger welling up in his body.
"Got it." He responded lightly, turned and left.
The back is thin, but straight.
Lin Hu stared at his back and spat: "Trash is trash, how can you pretend to be calm?"
------
2. The night is deep and the curculigo breaks through the barrier
night.
Lin Yaochen sat cross-legged on the bed in the dilapidated courtyard, and outside the window could be heard the howling wind in the back mountain.
He took out a palm-sized wooden box from his arms.
Open.
A red herb with roots like dragon's whiskers lay quietly.
Curculigo.
A top-grade ordinary-level medicine that breaks barriers, strengthens yang, and stimulates potential. It is the key to breaking through bottlenecks.
"System, start refining."
[Start refining: Curculigo (ordinary top grade)]
[The medicinal power is being transformed...]
[Estimated breakthrough: third level medicine disciple (extreme pulse reinforcement + combat power doubled)]
Boom——
A stream of scorching hot air suddenly exploded from the dantian, rushing wildly along the residual veins.
Lin Yaochen groaned, and large beads of sweat instantly appeared on his forehead.
